text: NOW-A-DAYS one often hears the question, “What is going to become of our chestnut trees?” In fact, whenever the subject of trees is broached in the course of a conversation, this inquiry is bound to come out—not, as I believe, that the interrogator hopes to receive a satisfactory answer, but more in the way of a general query.
